violations.title: RTE TCS Food, Disposition
violations.observation: Observed the following ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food being held for more than the specified time/temperature allowed: 1) cooked mushroom 2) tarragon 3) whipped cream 4) vegetable stock
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be discarded if it: 1) exceeds 7 days or at 41F (except the time it is frozen); or 2) is in a container or package that does not bear a date or day. PIC DISCARDED THE AFOREMENTIONED FOODS.

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: 1) upstairs chemical dish machine was observed not sanitizing
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. DISCONTINUE USING THIS DISH MACHINE TO WASH, RINSE, AND SANITIZE. BRING ALL GLASSWARE TO THE KITCHEN DISH MACHINE. SERVICE AND REPAIR DISH MACHINE BEFORE USING IT FOR SANITIZING.

out_items.name: Required records available: shellstock tags, parasite destruction

violations.title: Shellstock Removed from Tagged or Labeled Container
violations.observation: Observed a batch of oysters in the walk-in cooler without any identification or shell stock tag.
violations.corrective_action: Shellstock that has been removed from the tagged/labeled container must have a system used to identify source. STAFF RETRIEVED THE SHELLSTOCK TAG FROM THE KITCHEN AND PLACED WITH IN THE SAME TRAY AS THE OYSTERS. KEEP ALL SHELLSTOCK TAGS WITH THE BATCH OF SHELLSTOCK. ENSURE A COPY OF THE SHELLSTOCK TAG IS KEPT WITH THE SHELLSTOCK IF THE BATCH IS DIVIDED INTO DIFFERENT COOLERS.

violations.title: Shellstock Record System, Label/Tags
violations.observation: Observed shellstock tags for mussels and oysters commingling in a plastic quart container. Shellstock tags were not kept in chronological order.
violations.corrective_action: Shellstock tags shall remain attached to the container in which the shellstock are received until the container is empty. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO SEPARATE SHELLSTOCK TAGS BY TYPE AND THEN KEPT IN CHRONOLOGICAL ORDER. WRITE THE DATE THAT THE LAST PIECE WAS SOLD ON THE TAG. RETAIN FOR 90 DAYS.

violations.title: Parasite Destruction
violations.observation: The following fish offered for service or sale in the ready-to-eat form was not frozen to ensure parasite destruction: tuna
violations.corrective_action: Before service or sale in ready-to-eat form, raw or partially cooked fish shall be: 1) frozen and stored at a temperature of -4F or below for a minimum of 7 days in a freezer, or 2) frozen at -31F or below until solid and stored at -31F or below for a minimum of 15 hours, or 3) frozen at -31F or below until solid and stored at -4F or below for a minimum of 24 hours. PIC WILL EMAIL EHS PARASITE DESTRUCTION LETTER OR VERIFY TUNA SPECIES.

violations.title: Cooling from 135F to 41F, No More than 6 Hours
violations.observation: The following cooked time/temperature control for safety food(s) are not being adequately cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours and to 41F within a total of six hours: cooked chicken was observed at 55f in the walk-in cooler. Upon discussion with PIC, chicken was cooked the day prior.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety foods shall be cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours and to 41F within a total of six hours to prevent the growth of harmful bacteria. Foods that have been temperature abused are to be discarded. PIC DISCARDED THE CHICKEN.
